project.name: SDLCAgent
project.description: Multi-agent AI coding assistant that understands multi-language codebases, generates code via LLM agents, reviews it with a second LLM, and iteratively improves it — all through a web UI.

layers.name: Frontend
layers.description: Single-page web UI for task input, model selection, RAG management, live streaming code preview, review feedback, and workspace file management.

layers.name: Backend API
layers.description: REST + SSE API server. Handles code generation (sync + streaming), RAG ingestion, workspace management, and project launching.

layers.name: Agent Orchestration
layers.description: Multi-agent workflow: retrieve context → coder writes code → reviewer checks → loop until PASS or max iterations. Two modes: sync (LangGraph StateGraph) and streaming (async SSE token-by-token).

layers.name: RAG / Vector Store
layers.description: Codebase ingestion pipeline: scan directory → AST chunking via Tree-sitter → embed via Ollama → store in ChromaDB → semantic retrieval for agent context.

layers.name: Workspace Manager
layers.description: Session-based virtual workspace: store generated files, apply to disk with backup, revert from backup, cleanup stale sessions.

data_flow: User enters task in TaskPanel → App.handleGenerate() → api.generateCodeStream() → POST /api/v1/agent/generate/stream
Backend: stream_agent() → RAG context retrieval → coder LLM (Ollama) → reviewer LLM → judge LLM → SSE events

SSE events flow: node_start → coder_token/thought_token → node_end(coder) → node_start(reviewer) → reviewer_token → node_end(reviewer) → [loop] → node_start(judge) → judge_token → node_end(judge) → done
Frontend: handleStreamEvent() dispatches to coderBuffer/thoughtsBuffer/finalFeedback/judgeBuffer → FilePreview, ReviewFeedback render live
On done: workspaceFiles populated → FileExplorer shows tree → WorkspaceActions can Apply/Revert to disk

app/main.py.purpose: FastAPI application entry point. Defines all REST endpoints, CORS, logging, SSE streaming endpoint.

app/core/config.py.purpose: Pydantic Settings class. All configuration: Ollama URL, model names, ChromaDB path, max iterations, logging. Exposes AVAILABLE_MODELS dict with 8 models (local + cloud).

app/models/schemas.py.purpose: Pydantic v2 request/response models for all API endpoints. 20+ schema classes.

app/agent/state.py.purpose: LangGraph AgentState TypedDict. Shared state across workflow nodes.

app/agent/workflow.py.purpose: SYNC LangGraph workflow. Builds StateGraph with 3 nodes (retrieve → coder → reviewer) + conditional loop. Used by POST /api/v1/agent/generate (non-streaming).

nodes.coder_node: ChatOllama + ChatPromptTemplate → generates code with [FILE: path][/FILE] format → parse_files_from_code()
nodes.reviewer_node: ChatOllama → reviews code → returns PASS or issue list → sets state.is_valid
nodes.should_continue: Conditional edge: if is_valid or max_iterations → END, else → coder_node

prompts.BASE_REVIEWER_SYSTEM: Strict Senior Code Reviewer. Check syntax, security, edge cases, performance, style. Respond PASS or list issues.

app/agent/streaming.py.purpose: ASYNC streaming agent. Yields SSE events token-by-token for live UI updates. Used by POST /api/v1/agent/generate/stream.

key_details.thought_splitting: Before first [FILE: or ``` marker, content is emitted as thought_token. After marker, as coder_token.
key_details.file_parsing: parse_files_from_code() regex: \[FILE:\s*(.+?)\](.*?)\[/FILE\] with DOTALL. Falls back to single generated_code.txt.
key_details.judge_node: LLM-as-judge evaluates whether reviewer feedback was addressed across iterations. Uses JUDGE_SYSTEM + JUDGE_USER_PROMPT with iteration_history JSON.
key_details.iteration_history: List of {iteration, draft_code, review_feedback, is_valid} dicts passed to judge.
key_details.template_safety: previous_draft_for_prompt passed as template VARIABLE (not concatenated into template string) to avoid { } parsing crashes.

app/rag/codebase_rag.py.purpose: ChromaDB vector store wrapper. Ingests codebase directories, retrieves semantic context for agent prompts.

methods.ingest_directory(repo_path, extensions): Scans directory with .agentignore filtering → ingests each file → returns {files_processed, chunks_created, logs}
methods.ingest_file(file_path): Reads file → chunk_code() → embeds → stores in ChromaDB with metadata
methods.retrieve_context(query, k=3): Semantic search → returns concatenated chunks with source annotations
methods.list_indexed_files(): Returns sorted list of all indexed file paths

app/rag/code_chunker.py.purpose: Tree-sitter AST-based code chunking. Splits source files at function/class/import boundaries for semantic RAG chunks.

tree_sitter_languages.kotlin: function_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, object_declaration, package_header, import_header
tree_sitter_languages.typescript/tsx: function_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, import_statement, type_alias_declaration, lexical_declaration

app/rag/code_chunker.py.fallback: If Tree-sitter parse fails or language unsupported → entire file as single chunk

app/rag/agentignore.py.purpose: .agentignore file parser/matcher. Glob-style patterns to exclude files/dirs from RAG ingestion.
pattern_syntax: folder/ → match directory at any depth
app/rag/agentignore.py.default_header: DEFAULT_AGENTIGNORE template written when creating new .agentignore

app/workspace/manager.py.purpose: Session-based virtual workspace. Stores generated files in .workspace/<session_id>/files.json, supports apply-to-disk with backup and revert.

src/main.tsx.purpose: React entry point. Renders <App /> into #root with StrictMode.

src/App.tsx.purpose: Root component. Manages all global state: models, generation, streaming buffers, workspace, toasts, logs. Orchestrates 5-column resizable layout.

key_functions.handleGenerate: Resets state, sets currentNode='coder' immediately, calls generateCodeStream()
key_functions.handleStreamEvent: Dispatches SSE events to buffer states (node_start, *_token, node_end, error, done)
key_functions.handleApply: Calls workspaceApply() → writes files to disk with backup
key_functions.handleRevert: Calls workspaceRevert() → restores originals from backup

src/App.tsx.layout: Left sidebar (ModelSelector + RagPanel) | Main: TaskPanel + 5-column ResizableColumns (FileExplorer | Thoughts | FilePreview | ReviewFeedback | Judge) | Bottom: LogViewer | Footer: StatusBar

derived_state.hasResults: generating || currentNode !== null || streamError !== null || finalCode !== '' || fileCount > 0 || finalFeedback !== '' || judgeEvaluation !== ''

src/api.ts.purpose: HTTP client. All backend API calls wrapped as typed async functions. SSE streaming via ReadableStream reader.
src/api.ts.sse_parsing: ReadableStream → TextDecoder → split on \n\n → parse 'data: ' lines as JSON StreamEvent

src/types.ts.purpose: TypeScript interfaces for all API types + SSE StreamEvent union type.

TaskPanel.tsx.purpose: Task input form. Textarea + max iterations slider + PonyTail toggle + Generate button.

ModelSelector.tsx.purpose: Dropdown selectors for coder and reviewer models. Fetches model list from /api/v1/models on mount.

RagPanel.tsx.purpose: RAG management panel. Custom path input (default), example project toggle, recent projects dropdown, Detect/Structure/Ingest buttons, BlacklistModal trigger, Launch button.

FileExplorer.tsx.purpose: Tree view of generated workspace files. Builds nested tree from flat path list.

FilePreview.tsx.purpose: Code viewer with file tabs. Live streaming: plain <pre> for performance. After streaming: SyntaxHighlighter with line numbers. Strips [FILE:] tags during live mode.

ReviewFeedback.tsx.purpose: Markdown-rendered review/judge feedback panel. Shows PASS/FAIL badge, live cursor during streaming.

ResizableColumns.tsx.purpose: 5-column flex layout with draggable dividers. DOM-direct width manipulation during drag (no React re-render), state commit on mouseup.

LogViewer.tsx.purpose: Resizable bottom panel showing timestamped execution logs. Auto-scrolls to bottom.

StatusBar.tsx.purpose: Footer bar showing coder/reviewer model names, last action, iteration count, help button.

Header.tsx.purpose: Top bar with project name and backend connection status indicator. Polls /health every 10s.

WelcomeModal.tsx.purpose: First-run help modal with 'How to Use' and 'Features, Tips & Tricks' tabs. Dismissable with 'Don't show again'.

WorkspaceActions.tsx.purpose: Apply/Revert/Cleanup buttons for generated files. Apply writes to disk with backup, Revert restores originals.

BlacklistModal.tsx.purpose: Modal for selecting files/folders to blacklist via .agentignore. Checkbox tree from detect-structure results.

CodeDisplay.tsx.purpose: Legacy single-file code display with SyntaxHighlighter + copy button. Used in backup version, superseded by FilePreview.

launcher.py.purpose: Single-command launcher. Finds free port, starts backend (uvicorn), waits for readiness, starts frontend (npm run dev).

examples/.purpose: Demo projects for testing: streamlit_dashboard (Streamlit+Plotly), todo_app (CLI). Each has its own launch.py.

rag_layer: app/rag/code_chunker.py → tree_sitter_python, tree_sitter_java, tree_sitter_cpp, tree_sitter_kotlin, tree_sitter_typescript, tree_sitter_javascript, tree_sitter_html, tree_sitter_css, tree_sitter_json, tree_sitter_markdown
frontend_core: src/App.tsx → src/api (generateCodeStream, workspaceInit, workspaceApply, workspaceRevert, workspaceCleanup)
src/components/RagPanel.tsx → src/api (ingestRepo, detectRepoLanguages, detectRepoStructure, updateBlacklist, launchProject, getRagStats)
src/components/BlacklistModal.tsx → src/api (updateBlacklist - dynamic import), src/types (RepoItem, UpdateBlacklistResponse)

backend.naming: snake_case for Python files/functions, PascalCase for classes
backend.error_handling: try/except in all LLM calls → graceful error messages, never crashes the workflow
backend.streaming: SSE format: 'data: {json}\n\n'. Anti-buffer headers (Cache-Control: no-cache, X-Accel-Buffering: no). await asyncio.sleep(0) after each yield for flush.
backend.file_format: [FILE: path/to/file.ext]\ncontent\n[/FILE] — LLMs instructed to use this. Regex parse with DOTALL flag.
backend.template_safety: Code containing { } must be passed as ChatPromptTemplate VARIABLE values, NEVER concatenated into template strings (causes 'unmatched {' errors).
backend.ponytail: PONYTAIL_RULES string prepended to system prompts when ponytail_mode=true. YAGNI-first: stdlib > native > dependency > one-liner > minimal code.

frontend.naming: PascalCase for components, camelCase for functions/variables
frontend.state_management: All state in App.tsx via useState. No Redux/Context. Props drilling to children.
frontend.streaming_ui: Plain <pre> during live streaming (avoids SyntaxHighlighter re-render cost). SyntaxHighlighter only after streaming ends. [FILE:] tags stripped during live mode.
frontend.resizing: DOM-direct style.width during drag (no React re-render). State commit only on mouseup.
frontend.styling: Tailwind utility classes. Dark theme (bg-dark-800/900/950, text-gray-300). border-dark-600 for separators.

key_algorithms.agent_loop: while iteration < max_iterations AND not is_valid: coder → reviewer → if PASS: break, else: coder gets reviewer feedback → repeat
key_algorithms.code_chunking: Tree-sitter parse → walk AST → collect text between chunk-boundary nodes (function/class/import) → merge small inter-declaration text (<40 chars) into preceding chunk
key_algorithms.agentignore_matching: fnmatch on path parts. Directory patterns match any segment. **/ prefix for recursive glob. Root-relative and filename-only fallback matching.
key_algorithms.workspace_apply: For each file: backup original if exists → write new content → touch .applied flag. Revert: copy backups back to original paths.
